_rubric: Blind to on/off-tag. G = the verbatim expresses a position this camp actually holds (opposed stance counts when the doc engages the camp's position). S = the verbatim is real but the camp lens or node is imposed on content that doesn't carry it ('From an X perspective, this ...'). U = no supporting source text: verbatim missing, or a non-claim such as an author bio or a bibliography entry. Single rater (CL), 2026-10-26.
